Each object sits alone inside its own cell, well separated from the others, none of them touching, all drawn at the same scale and lit the same way. Soft matte clay 3D illustration, children's storybook style, rich saturated colours, soft shadows. Soft even studio light coming from the upper left, gentle contact shadow directly under the object. The background behind every object is plain, perfectly flat, pure black (#000000). Every surface is smooth, blank and unmarked. The image contains only the object itself. The objects, in reading order from left to right and top to bottom, are:
  1. A four-storey apartment building with rows of windows and small balconies, a flat roof and a door at street level
  2. A small two-storey town house with a red tiled roof, one window upstairs and a front door downstairs, with a short flight of steps at the entrance
  3. A single-storey wooden house built from horizontal timber planks, with a shingled roof, a wooden door and two shuttered windows
  4. A simple single-storey house with earth-brown mud walls showing a woven lattice of sticks underneath, a straw roof and one small doorway
  5. A long indigenous Brazilian communal house, an arched hut thatched all over with dry straw down to the ground, with one wide doorway at the near end
  6. A wooden stilt house standing above shallow brown river water on tall timber poles, with a ladder going down to the water and a small veranda
